Eligibility of the target paper cannot be inferred from its title alone.
criterion_notes.c2: Unclear under BOTH the plain wording of Criterion 2 and the narrow 2026-10-13 rule-type mechanism reading because the full text of the target record (Dipura 2026, DOI: 10.1016/j.jum.2026.01.006) was not retrieved. Without the target full text, we cannot verify whether the target study examines a broad governance factor (plain reading) or a specific rule-type mechanism directly governing service access (narrow 2026-10-13 reading), so both decisions must be cannot_tell.

rationale: WRONG_PAPER_MISMATCH (paper_mention_mismatch; reason: "full text not accessible" for target record). The Record Metadata specifies single-author paper Dipura R. (2026), "Heterogeneous sanitation infrastructure and the governance of trade-offs in Cape Town: A critical institutionalist perspective", DOI: 10.1016/j.jum.2026.01.006 (published in Journal of Urban Management). However, the retrieved 30-page PDF is clearly a different publication: Romeo Dipura, Jochen Monstadt, Sybille Frank & Shaun Smith (2026), "Governing infrastructure heterogeneity: an intraurban analysis of sewerage infrastructures in Cape Town", Urban Research & Practice, DOI: 10.1080/17535069.2026.2662863. Confirming that these are two distinct articles rather than a renamed preprint, the retrieved Urban Research & Practice PDF explicitly cites the target Journal of Urban Management article (DOI: 10.1016/j.jum.2026.01.006) in its text (PDF Page 4) and reference list (PDF Page 27). Per screening rules, because the target paper's text is not present, decision and plain_criterion2_decision are set to "cannot_tell" with exclusion_code "NONE".
